title: Request for proposal for survey evidence and claims intake
not_questions: Adobe Workfront is excluded from this procurement.
Use fictitious vessel names for the field trial.
Keep legal terms in the supplier schedule.

questions.label: A.1
questions.text: Describe how AEM Assets would register vessel photographs delivered in Amazon S3 with inconsistent file names while preserving the survey identifier.

questions.label: A.2
questions.text: Explain the AEM Assets permissions for a port surveyor who may upload damage images but may never view photographs from another insurer.

questions.label: A.3
questions.text: Set out how AEM Assets would record that the policyholder withdrew permission to share a hull photograph with a repair yard.

questions.label: A.4
questions.text: Provide an AEM Assets test that distinguishes a revised survey photograph from an accidental duplicate.

questions.label: A.5
questions.text: Explain how AEM Assets would let a survey supervisor compare annotations from two independent inspections of the same vessel.

questions.label: B.1
questions.text: Describe how an AEM Forms claimant could enter damage to several cargo compartments under one vessel incident.

questions.label: B.2
questions.text: Explain how AEM Forms would deal with an acknowledgement lost after Salesforce created the claim. State how a clerk would find the original claim.

questions.label: B.3
questions.text: Specify an AEM Forms validation rule that routes an incident with an unknown sailing date to manual review.

questions.label: B.4
questions.text: Describe how AEM Forms would present a claim summary for a policyholder to review before submitting the loss notification.

questions.label: B.5
questions.text: Specify what the AEM Forms receipt would show if a claimant reported a second loss before the desk assigned the first claim.

questions.label: C.1
questions.text: Name the person accountable for the field trial and identify the ports where your proposed team can attend in person.

questions.label: C.2
questions.text: Provide one reference for a claims intake project involving an independent surveying company.

questions.label: C.3
questions.text: Explain how your company checks the professional indemnity cover of subcontractors assigned to marine claims.

questions.label: C.4
questions.text: State your daily rates for an on-site test lead and the travel expenses charged in addition.
